Simulate a 2D lid-driven cavity flow using OpenFOAM with the icoFoam solver.
The cavity is a square domain 0.1 m by 0.1 m.
Use a uniform 20 by 20 mesh.
The top wall (movingWall) is a moving wall with fixedValue velocity uniform (1 0 0), moving to the right at 1 m/s.
The bottom and side walls are stationary no-slip walls (fixedValue uniform (0 0 0)).
The fluid is incompressible with kinematic viscosity nu = 0.001 m²/s set in constant/transportProperties.
Set the time step deltaT to 0.002 and run to an end time of 0.5.
This gives a Reynolds number Re = U·L/nu = (1 × 0.1) / 0.001 = 100.
The flow is laminar and this serves as the classic lid-driven cavity benchmark case for validation against Ghia et al. reference data.
Use standard pressure and flux boundary conditions consistent with the icoFoam cavity tutorial setup (fixedFluxPressure on walls, zeroGradient for pressure where appropriate).
Write results at regular intervals so velocity fields can be extracted for centerline velocity profile comparison.
